title: Toronto Application 24 254930 Council-Gate Item History — Phase 65 Toronto application 24 254930 delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Toronto application 24 254930 delivery reporting pack. Toronto's item history records the Scarborough Community Council recommendation, July 29-31 City Council gate, and conditions that can withhold amendment bills for application 24 254930.
key_findings: The record identifies a specific Council item and decision window.
A revised wind study, land exchange, and laneway conditions sit upstream of amendment enactment.
The item remains upstream of by-laws, building permits, construction, completion, and occupancy.
why_it_matters: Which records separate Council adoption and infrastructure context from enactment, conditions, building permit, start, completion, and occupancy? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The record turns a broad housing-conversion question into a named municipal chain whose next legal and physical stages can be checked.
ftfn_relevance: Maintains the Ontario dossier's dated decision gate.
Prevents committee recommendation from being reported as final adoption.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The pre-meeting record does not establish Council adoption or enacted by-laws.
It does not prove condition compliance, permit issuance, financing, construction start, completion, or occupancy.
